unit_label: Section 6: Minimalbasis der Körper K_{n rho}
translation_source_policy: Translated directly from the audited German source slice. English control, where present in the source pack, is only a sanity witness for older algebraic-geometric vocabulary; this unit was not edited from a Dutch or English draft.

technical_exclusions.disposition: Section 7 and later content; not included in this checkpoint.

segment_summaries.content: Section heading: minimal basis of the fields K_{n rho}.
segment_summaries.choices: Minimalbasis is rendered as мінімальна база / минимальная база / minimalna baza, keeping the definition tied to the minimal number rho of basis functions.

segment_summaries.content: Overview: known theorems are stated in an expanded form enabled by the transfer principle and the existence of rational bases.
segment_summaries.choices: Übertragungsprinzip continues as principle of transfer; rational basis terminology is unchanged from Sections 3--5.

segment_summaries.content: Definition IV: a rational basis with only the minimal number rho of functions is a minimal basis; these functions are algebraically independent.
segment_summaries.choices: The definition is kept in italic prose across all four reader variants; no explanatory footnote is added.

segment_summaries.content: The facts are derived from the theorems of Lüroth, Castelnuovo, and Enriques, with original bibliographic footnote.
segment_summaries.choices: Cyrillic reader transcribes the names in prose but restores the bibliographic footnote in the original Latin script.

segment_summaries.content: Fact I: every K_{n1} has a minimal basis, namely a Lüroth function determined up to linear-fractional transformation.
segment_summaries.choices: lineargebrochen is rendered as дробово-лінійний / дробно-линейный / linearno-drobny to signal Möbius-type dependence without modernizing the math beyond the source.

segment_summaries.content: Fact II: for K_{n2}, a minimal basis exists always and, in general, only when algebraic extension of Ω is allowed.
segment_summaries.choices: Koeffizientenbereich Ω is rendered as coefficient field in the target languages because Ω is used as the base field throughout this paper; review remains noted.

segment_summaries.content: Fact III: for rho at least 3, minimal bases generally do not exist; characterization of special cases is not attempted.
segment_summaries.choices: The negative existence statement remains terse and source-faithful; no modern classification language is inserted.

segment_summaries.content: Begins Steinitz’s proof sketch of Lüroth’s theorem for K*_{11}.
segment_summaries.choices: Steinitz is transcribed in the Cyrillic reader as Штайницом in prose; the reference abbreviation A. a. O. stays Latin.

segment_summaries.content: Uses an involution form coefficient psi*(x); equal extension degrees imply identity of fields, and mutual rational dependence implies linear-fractional dependence.
segment_summaries.choices: Degree language is phrased with modern extension-degree vocabulary while preserving Noether’s field-comparison structure.

segment_summaries.content: By the transfer principle, Lüroth’s theorem admits a formulation for K_{n1}.
segment_summaries.choices: Transfer language is kept stable with earlier sections.

segment_summaries.content: Italic theorem: a minimal basis of K_{n1} consists of any function of the involution basis; any two functions of that basis are linearly fractionally dependent.
segment_summaries.choices: The phrase function of the involution basis is kept literal in all languages; it is not flattened to generator.

segment_summaries.content: Fact II is proved by Castelnuovo using the geometric theory of involution for K*_{22}; the transfer principle remains valid under finite algebraic extension.
segment_summaries.choices: Geometric theory of involution continues the Section 5 involution terminology, preserving the algebraic-geometric bridge.

segment_summaries.content: For Fact III, Enriques constructs a nonrational involution in three-dimensional space, yielding a K_{33} without a minimal basis.
segment_summaries.choices: Nonrational involution is translated literally, with dimensional space rendered in current mathematical prose.
